title: A creator grounded in rigorous research keeps the same ideas across versions aimed at audiences of different knowledge levels
body:
- The creator's approach starts with rigorous foundational research that establishes the underlying parameters of the work.
- Versions for educated non-experts translate the core concepts from the rigorous source into accessible language.
- Versions for general audiences deliver the same ideas through accessible narrative formats.
- Conceptual consistency is maintained across format changes, so each audience receives the same underlying claims in a form suited to their level.
- Case: a thematic universe rooted in scientific papers has been distributed as college-level pieces for educated non-experts and as common-man-level works like comics that deliver the same thematic messages through accessible narrative formats.
conversion: none — standing condition: lets one body of knowledge reach audiences at different knowledge levels without fragmenting its conceptual identity
